name: Selection preserves the exact body, flight profile, progress, point balance and pending adaptations
Early selection and changing a path after the first branch evolution are blocked
Origin-stage changes never heal, reset timers, shift mass goals or mint adaptation points
Every route follows its complete distinct sequence without regular supergiant stages
A threshold awards once, holds below the goal and catches large gains one class at a time
Remnant abilities, achievements and supernova occur only at the actual remnant stage
Choosing at later stellar classes keeps that exact starting form and next mass target
Mass loss cannot unlock origin switching below Massive Star or silently de-evolve a branch
Nebula selection leaves orbits and stored matter intact until its transformation
Each precursor has a playable journey objective without requiring black-hole feeding
Precursor and mature saves reload without moving the body or replaying transformation
Every older 3.4 route tier migrates exactly once and retains its form, mass and point balance
New save schema rejects unknown versions, invalid origins and out-of-route tiers
Route inspector shows real stages, selection and locked state through the existing dock menu
Restart clears new path schema and origin state without duplicating loops or listeners
Precursor filaments have changing route-specific frames and respect Reduced Motion
